newsitem.title: USA: Greenpeace protestors arrested at start of Earth Summit.
newsitem.headline: Greenpeace protestors arrested at start of Earth Summit.

text.p: Police arrested two protesters from the environmental group Greenpeace on Monday when they attempted to unfurl a large banner protesting against global warming outside a U.N. "Earth Summit".
The banner showed the Statue of Liberty up to its waist in water and said, "Global warming is deep, deep trouble".
A Greenpeace spokeswoman said the protest was intended to draw attention to rising water levels caused by global warming.

She and a police spokesman said the two men were arrested before they could unfurl the 50 feet (15 metres) by 30 feet (9 metres) banner. Police said the men, both from New York, were charged with posting a sign without a permit.
Greenpeace is one of two Non-Governmental Organisations invited to the conference, which opened on Monday to take stock of progress since the 1992 Earth Summit in Rio de Janeiro.
